difficulty_reason: The counted lemma is the author lemma at source lines 971-976: if f is regular and lambda definable then the function g defined by minimization over f is lambda definable. The author proof (977-995) exhibits the search term and the fixpoint term, then verifies the reduction behavior of the applied fixpoint combinator on numerals: it reduces to the numeral m when f is zero at m and otherwise to the same term with m+1, and regularity of f guarantees the search terminates at the least witness. Writing out the self-application loop and its reductions is real lambda-calculus work, and the fixpoint combinator is used as the unit's standard tool.
